parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in paging query. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: DestinationIds
parameters.description: The list of access destination instance IDs.

parameters.name: DestinationType
parameters.description:
The type of the access destination. Valid values:
- **Connector**: connector.

parameters.name: ForwardIds
parameters.description: The list of forwarding rule IDs.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the forwarding rule.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in paging query. Valid values: 1 to 1000.
